answer.summary: Change routes three JsonFactory byte-parser paths through makeChildOrPlaceholder and guards addName/_addName with isCanonicalizing(). Existing PlaceholderSymbolTableTest defines the placeholder contract (findName null, addName throws, release safe) the parsers now depend on; the only _symbols.addName callsites in both parsers are inside the guarded methods. Risk: no existing test disables CANONICALIZE_FIELD_NAMES for DataInput/async parsers, INTERN_FIELD_NAMES is silently dropped in placeholder mode, and behavior diverges from ByteSourceJsonBootstrapper which falls back to ReaderBasedJsonParser.
